clause_text: The monthly rent is INR 25,000, payable by the 5th of each month.
A refundable security deposit of INR 75,000 is required.
Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice.
Consultant shall be paid INR 1,50,000 per month within 7 days of invoice.
All work product created shall be owned exclusively by the client.
Freelancer agrees to maintain confidentiality of all client data.
